description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values for several language-family categories, with six model/setting series shown side by side within each category and error bars indicating variability. The horizontal axis contains the categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, an unlabeled category (shown with a gray highlight under the tick), and Uralic, presented in that left-to-right order; the vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30 (values extending slightly below 0 and up to the mid-30s). Within each category, the grouped bars correspond to the legend entries mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with a vertical black error bar and caps. Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (mBERT-L₂ ~2, XLM-L₂ ~1, mBERT-R₂ ~3, XLM-R₂ ~3, mBERT-B₂ ~6, XLM-B₂ ~5); IE-Germanic shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~10 each, mBERT-R₂ near ~0, XLM-R₂ slightly below 0, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ near ~15 each; IE-Indic shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~20, XLM-R₂ ~18, mBERT-B₂ ~24, and XLM-B₂ ~21; IE-Romance shows mBERT-L₂ ~6, XLM-L₂ ~4, mBERT-R₂ ~5, XLM-R₂ ~1, mBERT-B₂ ~12, and XLM-B₂ ~6; IE-Slavic shows mBERT-L₂ ~10, XLM-L₂ ~9, mBERT-R₂ ~1, XLM-R₂ ~0, mBERT-B₂ ~17, and XLM-B₂ ~15; IE-other shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ around ~6 each, mBERT-R₂ ~0, XLM-R₂ slightly below 0, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~8 each; Isolate shows values clustered near zero to low positives (mBERT-L₂ ~0, XLM-L₂ ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~1–2, XLM-R₂ ~1, mBERT-B₂ ~1, XLM-B₂ ~2); the unlabeled gray-highlighted category shows mBERT-L₂ ~11, XLM-L₂ ~16, mBERT-R₂ around −2, XLM-R₂ around −1, mBERT-B₂ ~15, and XLM-B₂ ~19; and Uralic shows small positive values near ~0–2 across series (with mBERT-B₂ around ~2). The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by height, and aside from the gray highlight under the unlabeled tick, no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent use of error bars.
